requirements: R1: Patch existing code to resolve statistically confirmed pattern of design review concerns (u=0.0270) regarding task status mismatches
R2: Identify and categorize the underlying defect event rootCausePatternId for the uncategorized invariant pattern

slices.title: Patch internal task status synchronization logic and categorize root cause
slices.jtbd: When implementing the patch for this epic, I want to correct the existing status evaluation logic and categorize its root cause pattern, so that tasks accurately reflect the GitHub unmerged state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a GitHub PR that is closed without being merged
When the system evaluates the corresponding internal task status
Then the task is not falsely marked as done
Given the fix is implemented
When the root cause is analyzed
Then the underlying defect event carries the newly categorized rootCausePatternId
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the reviewConcerns stream rate from u=0.0270 to 0.0000
